body: The `.netrc` link in the [netrc files](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/concepts/authentication/http/#netrc-files) section points to https://everything.curl.dev/usingcurl/netrc. I'm not sure whether the link was originally intended to point to https://everything.curl.dev/usingcurl/netrc.html .
title: Fix broken .netrc documentation link
